sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B Transformer Model - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B Model is a dense transformer-based language model featuring 4B parameters and specialized procedural demonstrations. Supervised fine-tuning with LoRA adapters and a chain-of-thought protocol significantly improves its step-by-step reasoning performance. It leverages extensive multilingual tokenization and a vast pretraining corpus to excel in various downstream tasks.
